name: SkipCapture
grammar: grammar SkipCapture { @package: org.example.skipmapping @whitespace: javaStyle @root @mapping(Root, params=[hidden,visible]) Root ::= Hidden @hidden Visible @visible; @skip @mapping(Ghost) Hidden ::= '😀' Child 'z'; @mapping(Child, params=[value]) Child ::= 'q' @value; @mapping(Visible, params=[value]) Visible ::= 'v' @value; }

name: SkipQuantified
grammar: grammar SkipQuantified { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root @mapping(Root, params=[maybe,many,group,alias]) Root ::= [Hidden] @maybe {Hidden} @many ('|' 'g') @group Alias @alias; Alias ::= Child; @skip @mapping(Ghost) Hidden ::= 'x' Child; @mapping(Child, params=[value]) Child ::= 'q' @value; }

name: SkipRoot
grammar: grammar SkipRoot { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root @skip @mapping(Ghost) Root ::= Child; @mapping(Child, params=[value]) Child ::= 'q' @value; }

name: SkipAliasRoot
grammar: grammar SkipAliasRoot { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root Root ::= Hidden; @skip @mapping(Ghost) Hidden ::= Child; @mapping(Child, params=[value]) Child ::= 'q' @value; }

name: SkipScope
grammar: grammar SkipScope { @package: org.example.skipmapping token ID = org.unlaxer.parser.clang.IdentifierParser @root @mapping(Root, params=[hidden,ref]) Root ::= (Attempt '!' | Hidden) @hidden Ref @ref; @scopeTree(mode=lexical) @skip @mapping(Ghost) Attempt ::= Decl; @skip @mapping(Hidden) Hidden ::= Decl; @declares(symbol=name) @mapping(Decl, params=[name]) Decl ::= ID @name ';'; @backref(name=name) @mapping(Ref, params=[name]) Ref ::= ID @name; }

name: SkipRightAssoc
grammar: grammar SkipRightAssoc { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root @mapping(Root, params=[hidden]) Root ::= Hidden @hidden; @skip @mapping(Ghost, params=[left,op,right]) @rightAssoc @precedence(level=10) Hidden ::= 'x' @left { '^' @op Hidden @right }; }

name: SkipMixed
grammar: grammar SkipMixed { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root @mapping(Root, params=[choice,items]) Root ::= (Hidden | Visible | 't') @choice { (Hidden | Visible | 't') @items }; @skip @mapping(Ghost) Hidden ::= 'h' Child; @mapping(Visible, params=[value]) Visible ::= 'v' @value; @mapping(Child, params=[value]) Child ::= 'q' @value; }

name: SkipShared
grammar: grammar SkipShared { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root @mapping(Root, params=[hidden,visible]) Root ::= Hidden @hidden Visible @visible; @skip @mapping(Item, params=[wrong]) Hidden ::= 'h' @wrong; @mapping(Item, params=[value]) Visible ::= 'v' @value; }

name: SkipAliasChain
grammar: grammar SkipAliasChain { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root @mapping(Root, params=[alias,group]) Root ::= First @alias ('-' First) @group; First ::= Second; Second ::= Hidden; @skip @mapping(Ghost) Hidden ::= '😀' Child; @mapping(Child) Child ::= 'q'; }

name: SkipOwnEffects
grammar: grammar SkipOwnEffects { @package: org.example.skipmapping token ID = org.unlaxer.parser.clang.IdentifierParser @root @scopeTree(mode=lexical) @mapping(Root, params=[hidden,ref]) Root ::= Hidden @hidden Ref @ref; @skip @declares(symbol=name) @mapping(Ghost, params=[name]) Hidden ::= ID @name ';'; @backref(name=name) @mapping(Ref, params=[name]) Ref ::= ID @name; }

name: SkipQuoted
grammar: grammar SkipQuoted { @package: org.example.skipmapping token Q = org.unlaxer.parser.elementary.SingleQuotedParser @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= Hidden @value; @skip Hidden ::= Q; }

name: SkipChoiceRoot
grammar: grammar SkipChoiceRoot { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root Root ::= Hidden | Visible; @skip @mapping(Ghost) Hidden ::= 'h' Child; @mapping(Child) Child ::= 'q'; @mapping(Visible, params=[value]) Visible ::= 'v' @value; }

name: SkippedChoice
grammar: grammar SkippedChoice { @package: org.example.skipmapping @root @mapping(Root, params=[value]) Root ::= Hidden @value; @skip @mapping(Ghost) Hidden ::= First | Second; @mapping(First) First ::= 'a'; @mapping(Second) Second ::= 'b'; }
